purpose: Analyst target evidence comparison; no network calls or synthetic target substitution

metricDefinitions.agreement: Legacy exact matches / entire cohort; not comparable-pair agreement
metricDefinitions.pairAgreement: Exact matches including target analyst count / complete comparable pairs; null when no pairs
metricDefinitions.fullTriples: Low, consensus, high and same settled-close value; does not require an analyst count
metricDefinitions.consensus: Consensus and same settled-close value only; cannot establish low/high parity
metricDefinitions.targetDates: Same capture day permits observation-only comparisons; strictPass additionally requires equal explicit target revision dates on every pair
